name: El Último Pensamiento
source:
Your thoughts shape you. They define your relationship with yourself and your interactions with the world and those who inhabit it. As you experienced your own path, learning, and values are acquired and those will change the way everything that matters happens, allowing you to change things or let them change you, leading to different decisions and outcomes, both for the inhabitants of the city as for you and the universe.

Trying to understand those around you and helping them is actively reflected in your relationship with the world (and yourself), learning from them can be useful, but also difficult and demanding, so you can always choose to do it or not, you owe nothing to anyone.

Will you accept the beliefs of others because they are just convenient? or will you stay true to your own ideals while facing the consequences?

[from [url=https://gealacharts.itch.io/the-last-thought]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的想法塑造了你。它们定义了你与自己的关系以及你与世界以及居住在其中的人们的互动。当你经历自己的道路、学习和价值观时，这些将改变一切重要发生的方式，让你改变事物或让它们改变你，导致不同的决定和结果，无论是对于城市的居民还是对于你和宇宙。

尝试了解周围的人并帮助他们会积极反映在你与世界（和你自己）的关系中，向他们学习可能有用，但也很困难和要求很高，所以你总是可以选择做或不做，你不欠任何人。

你会因为别人的方便而接受他们的信仰吗？或者你会在面对后果的同时坚持自己的理想吗？

[来自[url=https://gealacharts.itch.io/the-last-thought]itch.io[/url]]
